title: Grep, string and format rules
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for Aho-Corasick literal scanning, portable grep rules, Unicode and entropy security checks and strict JSON and copy formatting.
boundaries: All regex, literal, Unicode, SHA-256 name-hash and Shannon-entropy scans run offline over local text buffers and never contact external services.
Matched secrets, high-entropy tokens and hashed blocklist hits are masked in diagnostic reports so cleartext credentials never leak into receipts.
Every codepoint bound, entropy cutoff, safe-integer bit-width and caption line limit resolves from default_grid_spec.json and passes ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for Aho-Corasick literal scanning, portable grep rules, Unicode and entropy security checks and strict JSON and copy formatting

value.lets_workers: Scan multi-pattern literal catalogs in single-pass O(|text| + matches) time with AhoCorasickAutomaton, enforce ECMA-262 regex portability and sentence-level negation rules with PortableGrepRuleRunner, catch Trojan Source bidi overrides, Unicode Tag ASCII smuggling, SHA-256 hashed name leaks and mixed-class high-entropy secrets with UnicodeAndEntropySecurityScanner and enforce canonical duplicate-free JSON and clause-balanced captions with StrictJsonAndCopyFormatter.

flow.when: Run single-pass Aho-Corasick multi-pattern scans, validate ECMA-262 regex portability, scrub local home paths and check sentence-level outbound negation, secret prefixes, accusatory copy and placeholder stamps.

Verify NFC normalization, decode hidden Unicode Tag block payloads, flag Trojan Source bidi/zero-width/variation-selector characters, check SHA-256 name-hash blocklists and mask high-entropy tokens while exempting lowercase hex digests.
Independently verify strict duplicate-free canonical JSON, reject raw HTML entities and em-dashes, wrap clause-balanced two-line captions and confirm ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Made-up multi-pattern, portable regex, Unicode Tag smuggling, SHA-256 name-hash, Shannon-entropy and strict JSON/caption bundle recomputed in test_rule_engine.py: matches whole-word Aho-Corasick literals, rejects lookbehind regex syntax, scrubs /Users/demo_worker/ paths, decodes hidden Tag payload 'hidden', exempts a 64-char SHA-256 digest while masking a 4-class high-entropy token, rejects duplicate JSON keys and wraps a clause-balanced two-line caption.

nouns.title: Guardrail: security diagnostics mask matched secrets and exempt 32..64-char lowercase hex content digests
nouns.category_reason: Prevents diagnostic reports from echoing cleartext secrets while avoiding false-positive blocks on SHA-256 pins.

value.rule: Never emit full cleartext tokens for secret-prefix, high-entropy or SHA-256 name-hash hits, and always exempt 32..64-character lowercase hexadecimal digests from Shannon-entropy masking.
value.how_it_is_checked: PortableGrepRuleRunner and UnicodeAndEntropySecurityScanner truncate matched tokens to configured prefix lengths and unit tests verify 0 false positives on 32-char MD5 and 64-char SHA-256 digests.

nouns.title: Guardrail: codepoint ranges, entropy thresholds, safe-integer bounds and caption limits forbid inline magic numbers
nouns.category_reason: Forces every scanner range and formatting threshold into externalized configuration grids.

value.rule: Operational Python functions and classes in rule_engine may only inline canonical mathematical identities (-1, 0, 1, -1.0, 0.0, 1.0); all Unicode ranges, bit-widths, entropy cutoffs and line-length bounds resolve from default_grid_spec.json.
value.how_it_is_checked: ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.scan_paths statically scans every module in rule_engine during make check.

nouns.title: Specification: Aho-Corasick, ECMA-262 regex portability, Unicode security ranges, entropy bounds and strict JSON invariants
nouns.category_reason: Defines deterministic multi-pattern scanning, Unicode codepoint blocks, IEEE-754 integer bounds and caption rules.

nouns.title: Sentence-level outbound negation, mixed-class Shannon entropy and orphan-free clause-balanced caption procedure
nouns.category_reason: Zero-model deterministic text hygiene and formatting procedure.

value.negation_exemption_rule: Split prose on sentence terminators and allow outbound effect words only when the same sentence carries an explicit negation cue.
value.caption_balance_rule: Enforce minimum two words per wrapped line, forbid line breaks immediately after unpunctuated prepositions/articles/conjunctions and reward clause-punctuation splits.

does: Runs single-pass O(|text| + matches) AhoCorasickAutomaton scans and PortableGrepRuleRunner checks for ECMA-262 portability, outbound negation, secret prefixes, home paths, accusatory copy and placeholder stamps.
Detects non-NFC text, Trojan Source bidi overrides, zero-width/variation-selector characters, Unicode Tag ASCII smuggling, SHA-256 hashed blocklist names and high-entropy secrets.
Enforces duplicate-key/NaN/unsafe-int rejection in JSON, HTML entity and em-dash checks and clause-balanced two-line caption wrapping verified by ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
